race.comment: SISTER MARY (3) didn't feature in the Belmont Oaks but got the job done last start at Pinjarra when racing over 1800m. Out in trip is no issue and she rates highly on the last start effort. Expecting her to settle much closer from a better gate this time and she can bring up back-to-back wins. GRANDAD'S ADICTION (15) flew home last start to miss out by 0.8L when getting well back and now draws much better. He remains down in the weights and the rise in trip won't be an issue. Expecting him to sit closer this time and can return to winning ways. WILD THINGS (4) was solid last time out over this trip at Northam when sitting just off the speed and ending up 2L away. This shapes similarly with Chris Parnham now on board. Can feature once again. SAVIENNE (7) won well two back before being outclassed in the Oaks. Has claims coming back to this level for CJP. LUKA MAGIC (2) can go on with the job after a good win at Pinjarra last time.
